summary: Requested a repeat of the fixed startup boundary experiment (3ba6c806449c483190a5cb2051f1ebc0-experiment), whose run produced receipt 5298e93f6b814e72be0a4b16cfb10633. That receipt is the account's central evidence that a real cluster prefix whose snapshot leaves 129 replay batches blocks inside NewRaft while the same prefix at 128 batches returns in milliseconds, and the two cases differ by a single committed entry, which is what makes the boundary a property of the batch count rather than of replay volume. The pair currently rests on one execution. Re-running the same retained inputs re-executes all three prefixes, so the pair is either confirmed or shown to depend on that run's scheduling, and the twenty-second observation window on the blocked case is exercised a second time. No code, inputs or measurements change; the submission is a repeat request with rationale only and validates against submission.schema.json.
